text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: page fired for INCIDENT-2026-4312 - surge of 429s from gateway-rate-limiter across eu-west-1. Trigger: 5xx/429 ratio > 10% for 10m.

maria (oncall): saw the page, jumping in. anyone oncall with context for adaptive limiter?

devon: i've been watching increased retry loops from our edge autoscaler since 07:02Z. 429s started ~07:15Z. looks like limiter config got a new release around that time.

ajit: i rolled the adaptive-backpressure tweak this morning (canary) but it shouldn't hit prod yet. pushing logs now.

maria (oncall): @pagerduty acked by maria (oncall).

pagerduty: incident acknowledged by maria (oncall) at 2026-03-14T07:21:08Z. escalation timer paused.

liam: quick check — metrics show token_bucket_fill_rate dropping to zero for multiple limiter pods. stack traces show panic in mapper when quota_key missing.

emily: customer impact: our ES-proxy reports 12 distinct customers with >50 requests failed (429) in last 10m, 3 are paid enterprise seats. raising severity to SEV-2.

maria (oncall): plan: 1) cut traffic to legacy-limiter fallback 2) roll back the adaptive-backpressure deployment 3) patch quota-mapper to handle missing keys. Who can run the rollback?

devon: standing by to run rollback. kubectl command ready.

ajit: confirmed bad change - null quota_key edge-case slipped through unit tests. prepping hotfix but rollback first.

maria (oncall): devon please execute the rollback and switch routing. i'll notify support for customer comms.

devon: running now:

```
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/adaptive-backpressure --to-revision=2
kubectl -n inference scale deployment/legacy-limiter --replicas=6
```

devon: rollback applied, legacy limiter scaled. verifying metrics...

liam: seeing decrease in 429s at the edge within 30s, token_bucket metrics recovering.

emily: customer impact trending down. outreach list prepared for the 3 affected enterprise customers.

maria (oncall): nice. next: keep the rollback, disable the canary deployment, and apply quota-mapper patch in dev then staged rollout. ajit, can you cut a hotfix and a short-lived feature-flag so we don't reintroduce this?

ajit: will cut hotfix now. creating PR with guard for missing quota_key and feature flag default off.

ajit: PR link: https://git.redwood.dev/adaptive-limiter/pull/492 - includes tests

devon: i've added a temporary rule in routing that pins traffic to legacy limiter for customers with high SLA until patch verified.

maria (oncall): going to handoff to devon for next 2 hours. i'll update the incident channel and open a postmortem. oncall handoff: maria -> devon at 07:34Z.

devon: ack handoff. i'll watch metrics and validate customer retries for 30m windows.

incident-bot: automatic note: on-call handoff recorded. maria (oncall) -> devon at 2026-03-14T07:34:20Z.

emily: summary for support: approx 07:15-07:22Z elevated 429s due to limiter rollback issue after canary; mitigation performed at 07:22Z. affected: 12 customers, 3 enterprise; transient failures, automatic retries should have recovered many requests.

liam: adding log snippet where mapper panicked:

```
2026-03-14T07:16:03Z error quota-mapper: panic_nil_key at /src/mapper/main.go:142
stack: runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference
```

maria (oncall): action items logged: 1) postmortem and root cause, 2) add unit test for missing quota_key, 3) tighten canary gating and increase observability thresholds, 4) run a small chaos test for limiter failure.

devon: will keep the legacy limiter until hotfix validated. will update status in 30m or earlier.

emily: i'm prepping customer comms draft, will wait for confirm that all enterprise customers show <=1 failed request in last 10m.

maria (oncall): closing pagerduty escalation for now but keeping incident open in channel. final state: mitigation successful, active monitoring for 1 hour. thanks all :thumbsup:

pagerduty: incident status changed to MONITORED by maria (oncall).

maria (oncall): tagging for postmortem: @eng-runtime, @eng-sre, @eng-ml (adaptive limiter owner). please include timeline, deploy gating gaps, and customer impact in the PM.

devon: noted, will draft timeline.

emily: will follow up with support tickets list and outreach notes.

maria (oncall): good job team. end of thread for initial mitigation.
